dedupe_keys.name: k means based load estimation of domestic smart meter measurements

description: K-means based load estimation of domestic smart meter measurements is a data set deposited in Cardiff University by its authors A Al-Wakeel, J Wu. A load estimation algorithm based on k-means cluster analysis was developed. The developed algorithm applies cluster centres from previously clustered load profiles and distance functions to estimate missing and future measurements. Canberra, Manhattan, Euclidean, and Pearson correlation distances were investigated. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2016. Formats: CSV. Size stated: < 100MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
